title: Route NIP-34 repository operations through repository relay hints
observed_behavior_before: Repository announcement parsing extracted 30617 relays tag values into relayUrls.
Repository selections copied relayUrls from parsed repository records.
Branch lookup for NIP-34 30618 repository state queried the globally connected Nostr relays only.
intended_behavior: Repository selections preserve relayUrls from 30617 relays tags.
30618 branch/state lookup uses scoped filters and queries repository relay hints before global Bahia read relays.
When selected NIP-34 repositories have no relay hints, branch lookup uses global Bahia relays only as a degraded fallback and exposes degraded metadata.
Incomplete EOSE metadata remains visible, including relay summary and partial event count.
